author: Dalium
body: Today when I was playing Nebula, I just died and yelled 'NOOOOOO'. And then I was out of the game. Truth is that i didn't quit. My game crashed because I was doing backups on my flash drive at the same time. The computer just overloaded. I know the circumstances made it look like it was on purpose, but it was just the worst timing. I was banned by TenBucksOfMoney at 3:27:12 AM on 4/25/15 (The temp ban screen says 26th, but that's tomorrow)
